purpose: Define `#WEB` site hierarchy as explicit recursive site/page structure owned by nanoCMS, independent from filesystem layout and MetaModule semantics.

topics.name: nanoCMS Site Tree
topics.purpose: Define `#WEB` site hierarchy as explicit recursive site/page structure owned by nanoCMS, independent from filesystem layout and MetaModule semantics.

semantics.identity_rule: Every site-tree node has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.recursive_rule: Site-tree nodes may contain child structural nodes recursively.
semantics.path_rule: Route/path is a binding of a node, not its semantic identity.
semantics.module_rule: Placed MetaModules are referenced/bound to nodes and retain their own semantic ownership.
semantics.order_rule: Navigation/display order is explicit presentation metadata where used.

invariants.rule: nanoCMS owns canonical web/site structure, routes, navigation and MetaModule placement/bindings; it never becomes owner of the placed MetaModule's semantics.

hard_gates.condition: site/page identity inferred solely from URL/path
MetaModule semantics copied into nanoCMS ownership
filesystem hierarchy treated as canonical site tree
display order inferred from JSON order only

prose.summary: Define `#WEB` site hierarchy as explicit recursive site/page structure owned by nanoCMS, independent from filesystem layout and MetaModule semantics.
